p: Bernard's offensive role keeps growing, and young players will carry bigger roles in November and December.
As the offensive game ball winner with injuries thinning the WR room, he is a rising option in the passing game.
I think what Jeremy did yesterday was outstanding.
Bernard may get more opportunities at receiver after McCarthy reviews his play against New England.
A possible bump in targets or snaps if Pittman is limited or the coaches are unhappy with the receiver group.
